notes: Paper reports new limits on scalar dark matter couplings to electrons (d_me) and gluons (d_g) from 298-day frequency comparison between 171Yb optical lattice clock and 133Cs fountain microwave clock. Main result is improved constraint on d_me by factor ~1000 at m_φ ~ 5×10^-22 eV/c^2. Data points extracted from Fig. 4(b) and text statements. The coupling d_me is dimensionless and represents the scalar field coupling to electron mass. Local DM density ρ_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 is assumed in Eq. (5) for converting amplitude limits to coupling bounds. Limits are at 95% CL and include 3.0× rescaling factor to account for interference effects from velocity distribution of scalar fields. ScalarElectron type chosen because paper specifically constrains variations of electron mass m_e induced by scalar field couplings. | selector: text (sole candidate)
